verdict.rationale: Mangopay's own fraud tooling lets platforms define custom logic and rules that detect and mitigate suspicious activity, a narrow, fraud-only form of user-defined event rules. Webhooks only send notifications to other applications, so they are a developer building block rather than a rules engine, and automatic chargeback deductions are fixed system behavior. missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined event→action rules beyond fraud, documentation of which actions rules can trigger and how they are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Define custom logic to detect and mitigate fraud attempts on your platform
Create rules based on the user's interactions and traits of their browsing session, allowing you to detect bots, VPN usage, and other potentially suspicious behavior.
